Breach of a written Supply Agreement between Plaintiff and Defendant [E1].

Timeline:
- Jan 15, 2021: Parties sign Supply Agreement; Defendant to deliver 50,000 containers/month at $2.40/unit [E1].
- Mar 2021: Defendant delivers only 32,000 units, ~18,000 short of the minimum [E1].
- Apr 2, 2021: Plaintiff serves written notice of breach, 30-day cure demand [E1].
- May 2021: Deliveries fall to 21,000 units; no cure [E1].
- Jun 10, 2021: Defendant suspends all shipments, citing raw-material shortage [E1].

Damages: Plaintiff covered at $3.85/unit, ~$1.2M. Relief sought: $1,200,000 plus pre-judgment interest and costs [E1].
